list.loadFailed: The templates could not be loaded. {{detail}}

empty.title: No page templates yet
empty.body: A page template is the print sheet: paper size, the slots the labels sit in, the cut line and the order name setting. Columns, rows and gaps set it up in seconds; afterwards every slot can be dragged with the mouse or edited in mm.
empty.noLanguage: A design language is needed first
empty.noLanguageBody: Page templates belong to a design language. Create one in Settings under Design languages.
empty.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or belong to another design language.

leave.body: The changes to this template will be lost.

toast.saveFailed: The template could not be saved. {{detail}}
toast.createFailed: The template could not be created. {{detail}}
toast.archived: “{{name}}” archived (hidden from the list; not deleted).
toast.presetFailed: The preset could not be saved. {{detail}}
toast.deleteFailed: The template could not be deleted. {{detail}}

canvas.hint: Drag a slot: guides and mm distances appear. Hold Alt to skip snapping; Shift for several slots.

slot.heading: Selected slot
slot.none: Click a slot or drag a box to select several; add with Shift.
slot.origin: Measured from the top-left corner of the paper.

warn.fixInset: Set the edge margin to {{mm}} mm
warn.noInset: No margin solves it: move the slots away from the corners.
warn.ok: Slots are inside the paper and do not overlap.

warnHint.slot-outside: The part off the paper is not printed.
warnHint.label-larger-than-slot: The label does not fit the slot.
warnHint.mark-overlap: The cutter cannot read the mark, or the mark is printed over the label.

warnings.no-slots-sticker: The template has neither slots nor a sticker flow.
warnings.slot-in-printer-margin_one: {{count}} slot (bleed included) reaches into the {{marginMm}} mm edge the printer cannot print: {{slots}}. The edge may print incomplete.
warnings.slot-in-printer-margin_other: {{count}} slots (bleed included) reach into the {{marginMm}} mm edge the printer cannot print: {{slots}}. The edge may print incomplete.
warnings.label-larger-than-slot_one: The label diameter ({{diameter}} mm) is larger than {{count}} slot; the label runs over the slot line.
warnings.label-larger-than-slot_other: The label diameter ({{diameter}} mm) is larger than {{count}} slots; the label runs over the slot line.
warnings.mark-overlap_one: Registration marks hit {{count}} slot or enter the bleed + {{safeMm}} mm safe area: {{slots}}. Change the edge margin.
warnings.mark-overlap_other: Registration marks hit {{count}} slots or enter the bleed + {{safeMm}} mm safe area: {{slots}}. Change the edge margin.

grid.confirmBody: The paper size also becomes the grid's. You can undo with {{keys}} before saving.

cut.heading: Cut
cut.outlineOn: The cutter cuts along this line.
cut.bleedHint: The label image extends this far beyond the slot (against cutting drift). 0 = none.
cut.fileHint: The slot paths are also delivered as SVG.
cut.printerMargin: Printers cannot print the outer {{mm}} mm of the paper; the canvas shows it with a dashed line.
cut.marksHint: Print-and-cut machines align the print with these marks.
cut.near_one: Registration marks are too close to {{count}} slot: the mark enters the slot's bleed + {{safe}} mm safe area; the cutter cannot read it or it is printed over the label.
cut.near_other: Registration marks are too close to {{count}} slots: the mark enters the slot's bleed + {{safe}} mm safe area; the cutter cannot read it or it is printed over the label.

cell.heading: Cell label (order name)
cell.enabledHint: Turned on or off per page on the desk. The preview sits next to the first slot.
cell.positionHint: The position is relative to the slot's bottom right corner; in the rightmost slot of a row the text is placed relative to the one on its left.

tpl.name: Name
tpl.sizeHint: Which label size is printed on this paper (e.g. 3.8).
tpl.sheetIdHint: The ID of the sticker sheet in the design language.
tpl.labelDiameterHint: When empty the label fills the slot. The label is centered in the slot.

flow.heading: Row flow
flow.hint: Stickers are laid out in rows instead of slots; their sizes may differ.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: This template was never used in a print. It is deleted permanently; this cannot be undone.
delete.bodyUnknown: If it was never used in a print it is deleted permanently. If old prints used it, it is not deleted but moved to the archive.
delete.archiveBody_one: This template was used in {{count}} print. It is not deleted so past prints stay intact: it leaves the list and stays in the archive (visible with “Show archived”). You can restore it any time.
delete.archiveBody_other: This template was used in {{count}} prints. It is not deleted so past prints stay intact: it leaves the list and stays in the archive (visible with “Show archived”). You can restore it any time.

label.heading: Label
label.flowOnly: This sticker sheet has no slots; stickers flow in rows. Row flow settings are in the Advanced tab.

layout.heading: Layout
layout.confirmBody: Slots you moved, added or deleted by hand are placed again by the new layout. You can undo with {{keys}} before saving.

adv.pitchHint: Pitch: distance from center to center; the gap follows it. Setting a margin by hand turns off “Keep centered on paper”.
adv.evenFailed: The slots do not fit this paper; use fewer columns or rows.
